name: Spellscale
printedArtCredit: Ed Cox, Spellscale spot illustrations, pp. 24 and 36.
sourceDistinctions: The original racial traits explicitly grant low-light vision. Dragonblood is a subtype of this Humanoid, not Dragon type.
Blood Quickening is one meditation per day. Learned spells and spell slots are separate from temporary borrowed feats or cure/inflict item access.
The book’s Bard sample gives an unexplained claw attack; there is no racial claw attack in the species traits.
The existing Black Flag monster Spellscale Vassal is a distinct identity and keeps its profile and artwork.
portraitForm: Isette Mossglass, an original Spellscale Sorcerer
